ble.powod.bt_wylaczony: Bluetooth is off or unavailable. Turn it on in Start > Settings > Bluetooth & devices.
ble.powod.nie_widze: Cannot see the treadmill. Turn it on and close its phone app.
ble.powod.timeout: The treadmill is not responding. If this keeps happening, turn it off and on again.
ble.powod.nieobslugiwane: This device does not look like a treadmill. If it is one, report it in Settings > Help and diagnostics > Report a problem.
ble.wybierz_z_listy: Choose a treadmill from the list.
ble.stop_nie_zdazyl: Could not stop the belt. Stop it with the remote.
ble.stop_niepotwierdzony: The treadmill did not confirm the stop. Stop the belt with the remote or remove the safety key.
ble.predkosc_nieprzyjeta: The treadmill does not accept {kmh} km/h. Check that the belt is moving and try again.
